summary: Jack is back signature rapping style after releasing an R&B album earlier this year.
title: Sweet Action II
content:
Sweet Action II is honestly a nice listen. I really enjoy the laid-back production throughout the project. It has that early evening vibe that makes you want to sit back, relax and just let the music play. \
Playing the first track, for a moment I was like:

> Who is this woman JackMan is talking to?

I like how Jack approaches the different themes of love, relationships and growing up. There's a certain ease to his delivery that makes everything feel natural. I also don't mind the lack of singing compared to his previous work. If anything, I think the more conversational approach works well with the overall direction of the project.

It's still early, but I can already see this becoming one of those projects I'll revisit when I'm in the mood for something smooth and easygoing. Nothing too overwhelming, just good music and production that sets the right atmosphere.

My three favorite tracks from the project are:\
Hold back, Too Soon (feat. Babyface) and Pressure
verdict: A smooth, laid-back listen that doesn't try too hard, sometimes that's exactly what you need.
